description: Native PC port of Mario Kart Wii built by static recompilation, shipped as a setup program that translates and compiles the game from your own disc image.
notes: Contains no game code or assets: you need your own PAL, NTSC-U or NTSC-J disc image.
This is upstream's command-line setup. Build the game with: WiiCompiled-Setup --silent --game <disc image> --install-dir <target folder>
